subject.title: Discord plugin: channels added to channels.discord.guilds.*.channels.* post-startup are never subscribed (requires full gateway restart)

question: Is the existing generic `channels.discord` hot-reload-to-channel-restart path enough evidence to close this report, or should the team require live/focused Discord proof of the add-channel inbound flow before repair or closure?
rationale: Current source shows an intended generic restart path, but a newer production report says that path did not make newly added Discord channels receive inbound events; choosing whether source evidence is sufficient needs maintainer proof standards for this stable channel surface.

options.title: Require focused Discord proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a live or integration reproduction shows where the add-channel reload path fails, then repair that path.

options.title: Close from generic path
options.body: Treat the current reload prefix, planner, and stop/start executor as sufficient and close despite the newer reporter evidence.

options.title: Fold into broader dynamic-channel work
options.body: Move the remaining user need to the Discord pattern/category allowlist discussion, accepting that this issue's hot-reload claim remains unproven.

recommendation.title: Require focused Discord proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a live or integration reproduction shows where the add-channel reload path fails, then repair that path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history on the Discord allowlist/startup path and gateway reload helper surfaces involved in the proof decision.
